item.subject: science
item.stem:
The diagram shows Ishaan's digital clinical thermometer with its tip and display labelled. He will measure his sister's body temperature.

Which set of steps is correct?

options.A: Wash the tip, reset, place the tip correctly, wait for the beep, then read the display.
options.B: Wash the tip, reset, place the display under the tongue, then read after the beep.
options.C: Skip washing the tip, place the tip correctly, and read as soon as any number appears.
options.D: Wash the whole thermometer including the digital portion, then place the tip correctly.
